meta.name: Knowledge base
meta.description: Answers and how-to guides for everyone, troubleshooting guides for the service desk.

knowledge-reader.name: Knowledge reader
knowledge-reader.description: Read published self-service articles (granted to everyone by default)

knowledge-agent.name: Knowledge agent
knowledge-agent.description: Read internal articles, write drafts and submit them for review

knowledge-editor.name: Knowledge editor
knowledge-editor.description: Publish, retire and restore articles, edit any article and manage categories

permissions.write: Write drafts, edit your own drafts and submit them for review
permissions.publish: Publish, retire and restore articles, and edit any article
permissions.manageCategories: Create, edit and delete knowledge categories
permissions.sync: Write articles through integrations (publishing still needs the publish permission)

settings.reviewIntervalDays: Review an article this many days after it is published (0 = no default review date)
settings.reminderRepeatDays: Repeat overdue-review reminders every N days
settings.guidePublishHelp: Keeps "Using IS Big Platform" (the platform's user guide, in every language) in the knowledge base, updated with each new version. Turning it off stops publishing and updating; retire its articles to remove them.
settings.classificationLevelsHelp: One label per line, most restrictive first. Use strictly-confidential, customer-confidential, confidential or internal-use-only for the built-in (translated) labels, or write your own.

browse.label: Browse knowledge
browse.description: Find step-by-step answers to common questions and fix things yourself.

publish.name: Publishing a knowledge article
publish.description: Optional review before an article goes live. Conditions can use its audience, language and category.

feedback.thanksComment: Thanks — the author will see your comment.

manage.search: Search title, summary or KB number…

empty.mine: No drafts. Start a new article.
empty.due: All articles are up to date.

outcome.review: An editor reviews it before it goes live.
outcome.approval: It goes to approval first and is published once approved.

toast.updatedLive: Update published as a new version

errors.localeTaken: {reference} is already the translation in this language

categoriesAdmin.title: Knowledge categories
categoriesAdmin.description: Topics that group articles on the knowledge home.
categoriesAdmin.noAccess: You need permission to manage knowledge categories.
categoriesAdmin.dialogHint: Names and descriptions can be written in each language; English is the fallback.
categoriesAdmin.name: Name
categoriesAdmin.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used in links, filters and workflow conditions; it can't change later.
categoriesAdmin.iconHint: A lucide icon name, e.g. key-round, wifi, printer.
categoriesAdmin.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first on the knowledge home.
categoriesAdmin.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be deleted. Categories that still have articles can't be deleted.
